name: Fort Kochi Chinese Fishing Nets
description: Iconic fixed cantilevered Chinese fishing nets (Cheena Vala) lining the Fort Kochi promenade, best viewed during morning fish hauling or seaside sunrise walks.

name: Mattancherry Dutch Palace & Jewish Synagogue
description: Historical 16th-century Portuguese and Dutch palace with exquisite Ramayana murals, alongside the historic Paradesi Synagogue and antique spice markets in Jew Town.

name: Kerala Kathakali Centre
description: Intimate cultural theatre offering traditional Kathakali classical dance-drama, authentic facial makeup demonstration, and ancient Kalaripayattu martial arts shows.

name: Alleppey Backwaters Shikara Cruise
description: Traditional wooden shikara boat ride through the tranquil palm-fringed canals, Punnamada Lake, and serene rural paddy backwaters of Alappuzha.

name: Marari Beach & Fishermen Cove
description: Pristine white sand coastal beach near Alleppey, famous for tranquil coconut groves, peaceful sea views, and fresh coastal seafood stalls.

name: Marine Drive Promenade & Cochin Harbour Cruise
description: Scenic pedestrian boulevard facing the serene Vembanad lake backwaters in downtown Kochi, with sunset ferry rides past Bolgatty Island and Willingdon Island.

name: Hill Palace Museum (Tripunithura)
description: Largest archaeological museum in Kerala spread over 54 acres, featuring 49 traditional royal buildings, royal throne, crown jewels, and deer park.

name: Munnar Tea Gardens & Tata Tea Museum
description: Sprawling emerald green tea estates in the Western Ghats with factory demonstrations of CTC tea processing, tea tasting, and misty mountain lookouts.

name: Eravikulam National Park (Rajamalai)
description: UNESCO World Heritage sanctuary at 2,000m altitude home to the endangered Nilgiri Tahr mountain goat, Neelakurinji flower blooms, and view of Anamudi Peak.

name: LuLu Mall & Broadway Kochi Street Bazaar
description: Vibrant shopping and dining destination offering regional Malabar culinary feasts, Kerala banana chips, cardamom and black pepper spices, and souvenir shopping.
